column1: # Tennessee Administrative Office of the Courts: the news and press notices
# Read once on 2026-11-25 in the operator's own Chrome, with the directory.
# The courts' news list was read from its newest item (2026-11-23) back to
# 2020-09, and every item whose title names an appointment, an elevation, a
# retirement, a resignation or a death was opened (96 items; 48 from August
# 2022, when the present eight-year terms began). Kept here: the notices the
# builder uses to take a name out (never to add one; see the builder), each with the sentences it relies on, copied exactly. The two
# vacancy notices name the prior incumbent only in their attached PDF, which
# was read on screen. Columns, tab-separated: date, page, text.

column3: The Tennessee Supreme Court has appointed former Judge D. Kelly Thomas as a senior judge. He replaces current Senior Judge Thomas Wright, who is retiring. Judge Thomas' appointment will begin September 1, 2023 and is for a term of two years.

Governor Bill Lee appointed Emily Abbott to the 6th Judicial District Criminal Court, which covers Knox County, and William Lane to the 32ndJudicial District Circuit and Chancery Courts, which cover Hickman, Lewis and Perry counties, on Aug. 15, 2025. [...] He fills the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Michael Spitzer, effective immediately.

Governor Bill Lee appointed Chris Frulla to the Circuit Court and Raymond Lepone to the Criminal Court in Judicial District 30, which covers Shelby County. [...] Raymond Lepone currently serves as an Assistant Attorney General in the Office of the Tennessee Attorney General within the Criminal Appeals Division. Lepone earned his bachelor's degree at Kennesaw State University and juris doctor at Cecil C. Humphreys School of Law. He fills the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Paula Skahan, effective immediately.

Governor Bill Lee appointed Judge Jim Todd to the 20th Judicial District Criminal Court, which covers Davidson County. [...] Judge Todd fills the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Cheryl Blackburn.

Governor Bill Lee appointed Bethany Glandorf to the 20th Judicial District Circuit Court, which covers Davidson County. [...] Glandorf fills the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Phillip Robinson. Her appointment is effective immediately.

The Trial Court Vacancy Commission is withdrawing its previous notice and is issuing a new notice of vacancy in the 12th Judicial District. [Attached PDF, Notice Public Hearing 10012026.pdf:] Judicial District: District 12, Circuit Court Judge. Counties served: Bledsoe, Franklin, Grundy, Marion, Rhea, and Sequatchie. Appointment expiration: August 31, 2028. Prior incumbent: Hon. John Cameron.

The Trial Court Vacancy Commission met in Winchester to select nominees for a vacancy in the 12th Judicial District Circuit Court. After holding a public hearing and conducting public interviews, the Commission selected the following nominees: Claudia Coco Angel, Marshall (Mark) Raines, Jr., Jared Smith. [No appointment to this seat was announced in the courts' news through 2026-11-23, its newest item when read.]

The Trial Court Vacancy Commission is accepting applications for a criminal court judge in the 6th Judicial District. [...] The public hearing for this position will be Friday, December 11, 2026 [...] [Attached PDF, TCVC Notice_0.pdf:] Judicial District Counties served: District 6 Criminal Court Judge. Appointment expiration: August 31, 2028. Prior incumbent: Hon. G. Scott Green.
